# Tune proposal

Song intake is currently closed while the public repositories and trusted hosted
checks are prepared. An unconfigured contribution check does not grant permission
to merge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the current data contract.

For a song contribution, state the canonical TL hash and confirm that the PR
contains exactly its record, contribution declaration and appended catalog entry.
The declaration must be accepted by the actual submitter. A passing automated
check remains a proposal for maintainer review, not approval or publication.

For repository maintenance, describe the change separately; the song checker is
intentionally restricted to data-only song proposals. Do not alter its workflow
to make a submission pass.
